name: Mie

flag.description: A white emblem on a green field: the hiragana み (mi) drawn as an arrow pointing up, with a ring at its foot.
flag.symbolism: み is the first sound of Mie; the arrow stands for progress and the ring for the pearls farmed in Ago Bay.

hook: Mie's white み (mi) shoots up like an arrow from an Ago Bay pearl on bright green; Miyagi's み curls into leaves on dark green.
trivia: The Ise Grand Shrine, Shinto's holiest site, is in Mie.
Iga, in Mie, is famous as a home of the ninja.
